paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of and by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates effects across different language families and models using grouped bars to represent four model conditions. The horizontal axis contains the language family categories labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the labeled "effect", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, marked at intervals of 10. Each language family category contains four bars, which represent different model conditions indicated by color: light blue for mBERT-targ, dark blue for XLM-targ, light green for mBERT-permute, and dark green for XLM-permute. In the IE-Baltic category, the tallest bar is the dark blue bar at approximately 21, while the light green bar is the shortest at around 6. In the Isolate category, the tallest bar is the light blue bar reaching approximately 34, while the light green and dark green bars are near 0. Each bar within the categories is distinctly colored and grouped together, with no specific sorting order evident across the chart. Error bars are present on each bar to denote variability, some error bars reaching negative values. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color differentiation. A legend is given
